frozen_trigger_reminder: Frozen rule requires an official presidential invocation of the Act itself as legal authority for active-duty deployment or federalization of National Guard in response to civil disorder/insurrection/rebellion. A threat or a domestic Guard deployment under a different stated authority is not by itself proof of this exact event.
